title: GCZRec: Generative Collaborative Zero-Shot Framework for Cold Start News Recommendation
authors: Hassan, S. Z. U.; Rafi, M.; Frnda, J.
tldr: Proposes GCZRec, a generative zero-shot framework using conditional Wasserstein GAN to make cold-start news recommendations by synthesizing user-item interactions from latent features.
problem_and_motivation: Traditional collaborative filtering cannot recommend cold-start news items lacking historical interaction data. Existing techniques fail to incorporate collaborative information between users and items simultaneously, reducing serendipity and recommendation diversity.
approach: Formulated cold-start news recommendation as a zero-shot learning problem using item and user features.
Designed a generative framework (GCZRec) with two separate conditional Wasserstein GAN (cWGAN) networks for cold-start items and cold-start users.
Trained generator networks to synthesize interaction vectors using latent collaborative information.
Evaluated on two public datasets: Microsoft News Dataset (MIND) and Addressa.
Formulated the recommendation as an extreme multi-label classification task for efficient ranking.
findings: GCZRec framework enables both cold-start and warm-start news recommendations with collaborative signal integration.
Synthesized interactions from latent features eliminate the need for external click predictor models.
The framework can be used as preprocessing to improve existing recommender system performance.
Conditional WGAN generates diverse recommendations, improving serendipity over content-only approaches.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: This paper introduces a generative framework that bridges collaborative filtering and zero-shot learning to solve cold-start recommendation. It demonstrates that synthesizing interactions from latent user and item features using conditional GANs can produce diverse, serendipitous recommendations. The framework establishes a new paradigm for cold-start handling that preserves collaborative signals without requiring historical interaction data.
directly_justifies: Zero-shot learning effectively models cold-start recommendation problems.
Conditional WGAN synthesis preserves collaborative signals for diverse recommendations.
GCZRec generates both cold-start and warm-start recommendations in a unified framework.
limits: Evaluated only on news recommendation datasets, not financial or budgeting domains.
Computational cost of GAN training for large-scale systems not addressed. [unacknowledged]
No comparison with graph-based cold-start methods.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: Systematic scan across all 14 topic domains was performed. Domain 5.B (Cold-Start Problem) was flagged as high relevance because the paper's core contribution is cold-start recommendation methodology. Domain 7.E (Budget Recommendation Cold-Start) was flagged as high because the cold-start technique directly transfers to budget onboarding. Domain 5.C (Classification Approaches) received medium relevance for the classification methodology. All other domains were rejected.

limitations: Evaluated only on news recommendation; applicability to personal finance recommendation unverified. [unacknowledged]
No analysis of training stability or convergence of cWGAN for recommendation tasks.
MIND and Addressa datasets may not capture financial transaction interaction patterns.
